acceptance_status: Automated full-inventory checkpoint; full functional/native/manual/performance/release parity remains open.
scope: Twenty-two profile preference switches, two global switches and three clear-data checkboxes now use Rust model/display lists with Metal rendering and matching CPU fallback; Views Button nodes remain native event/focus/AX adapters.
geometry: Native 26x16 track and checked/unchecked/pressed thumb geometry, with a 38x28 adapter target to contain the focus ring and hover halo. This deliberately changes the target padding from native preferred geometry.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Committed archive with explicit prototype overrides, including page_dialogs.cc/h, and unchanged shared-service install/stage hooks, excluding concurrent root network-policy work. Final staging idempotent and Ninja no-work.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

additional_performance_scenario_coverage.purpose: Execute all four opt-in performance scenarios as additional automated coverage, with their default 30 trials. Metal validation is enabled; these are not controlled CPU/GPU/drawable presentation comparisons.

contracts: Rust owns checked state, enabled admission, reversible 80 ms slide and 250 ms hover interpolation, reduced-motion admission and clipped primitive generation. The adapter samples native colors and supplies typography/events/window/focus/AX.

Programmatic preference refresh snaps the slide just as native SetIsOn does. Hidden/offscreen switches stop their timer; window/profile transitions cancel latched input. CPU fallback animation requests native repaint when Metal is unavailable.

Cocoa Space toggles a real profile preference and checkbox on both backends. Switch checked AX state and the original Chromium camera service update together. Global animation/pinning settings remain global after changing profile.

The form selects only cookies for an all-time clear; confirmation still binds to the originally selected profile after switching profiles. Work cookies/localStorage/IndexedDB are removed and personal markers remain. The three checkbox AX values verify history/cache are unselected.

Metal-specific coverage verifies all 24 switches use no native ToggleButton or child-label painting, plus disabled admission, profile/hide cancellation, clear-checkbox hide cancellation, actual compositor viewport exclusion/reappearance and idle timer shutdown. Checked AX remains model-owned while pressed, disabled, cancelled and hidden, matching native Checkbox/ToggleButton overrides.
limits: Remaining preference actions/section navigation/form controllers and outer/native Views nodes are not migrated by this checkpoint.

Native candidate-window/VoiceOver/complex bidi/scale/theme/pointer/GPU-recovery and other manual acceptance remain open. The CPU fallback recipe/repaint path is implemented; device-loss acceptance is not established by these automated runs.
Optional default-30-trial performance scenarios provide execution coverage only; no controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation speedup is claimed.
Normal installed applications/profiles are untouched. No bundle is packaged or signed.
No new library/crate/dependency. Final Apache-2.0/upstream notice and shipped-binary license verification remain release acceptance.

initial_critical_investigation.cause: The native Button::SetState calls virtual UpdateAccessibleCheckedState, whose base implementation maps visual pressed state to checked=true and other states to no checked attribute. The Rust checkbox adapter (also used for import) and new switch adapter initially inherited it. Hiding/cancelling reset visual state and removed checked AX even though Rust state was intact.
initial_critical_investigation.initial_misdiagnosis: The initial hypothesis attributed absent AX to hiding. Merely reopening the same form still failed. Pinned native source inspection identified the actual Button hook.
initial_critical_investigation.fix: Override UpdateAccessibleCheckedState in SceneCheckbox and SceneToggle, as native Checkbox/ToggleButton do, sourcing checked state from the authoritative Rust model. Final coverage asserts model-derived checked AX while pressed, disabled, cancelled, hidden and reopened. No input/viewport/cancellation assertion was weakened.
